title.narrative: To build a strong foundation for a progressive move towards malaria elimination in Solomon Islands - Solomon Islands (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Solomon Islands, Malaria, Solomon Islands Ministry of Health and Medical Services (MHMS)This program has the following goals: To reduce Annual Parasite Incidence (API) from 88/1000 in 2016 to less than 63/1000 in 2020.. The objectives of this program are: To maintain high Long-lasting Insecticidal Net (LLIN) coverage, increase usage and target supplementary Vector Control measures based on epidemiological need.. To maximize access to and utilisation of early laboratory confirmed diagnosis and appropriate treatment for malaria. To support the Ministry of Health in strengthening health systems nationwide.. To maximize program impact through partnership and improved program management.
